preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100,000.
For each test case, the number of residents n and the number of friendship pairs m must be between 1 and 1,000,000.
Each friendship pair (a_i, b_i) must consist of valid resident and cat indices.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'No' or (stdout == 'Yes' and j + p == n)
postconditions.description: If it's impossible to select jury and contestants, output 'No'. Otherwise, output 'Yes' and ensure the sum of jury members and contestants equals n.
The number of jury members j and the number of contestants p must be at least 1.
The indices of jury members and contestants must be distinct and match the specified counts.
